_comment: Shared guard for the three-reader notify-channel default (W2 C10). For a LINKED account, notifications are Telegram-delivered iff notifyChannel !== 'push' — a MISSING/unknown channel reads as telegram, only an explicit 'push' opts out. The default is implemented once in shared/notifyDelivery.js telegramPreferred and consumed by js/notifySuppression.js botDelivered, js/notifyChannel.js render default, and functions/notifier.js sendToUser route gate. Consumed by tests/notifySuppression.test.js, tests/notifyChannel.test.js, and functions/test/notifier.test.js. telegramDelivered here is the linked-account expectation; the notifier additionally falls back to telegram when channel IS 'push' but the account has zero push tokens (W1 J#3) — a delivery-level extra, not part of this default, so it is out of scope for these vectors.
